{/* Hero */}
Est. 1936

Our Heritage

Four generations of halwais. One kadhai. A thousand afternoons spent stirring milk into magic.

{/* Bento Story */}
The Beginning

A halwai's tray, a city's sweet tooth.

Long before there was a signboard, there was a man, a brass tray and a reputation. Shri Netram would set up at dawn near the temple steps, his pedas wrapped in banana leaves, his ladoos still warm from the kadhai. Word spread, queues formed, and slowly the tray became a counter, the counter became a shop.

Nearly ninety years later, that quiet promise — to make mithai with patience and pure ingredients — still defines everything we serve.

Our Promise

Pure ghee. Local milk.
Recipes that haven't changed.

We make ghee in-house every morning. Our milk arrives from farms within a few kilometres. We use no artificial colours, no synthetic flavours, no shortcuts. Some sweets take a day; some take two. We'd rather wait.

{/* Milestones */}
Four Generations

A Note From The Family

Thank you for choosing a small shop.

Every box of barfi you carry home, every dabba of ladoos you send for a wedding, every quiet evening jalebi — keeps a family tradition alive. From our kitchen to your table, with gratitude.

— The Netram Molchand Family
